quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General manager Liu Taiguo (H1 2026 results briefing): demand for its high-speed interconnect products is strong, orders on hand are sufficient and growing, and overall capacity utilization stays high. The leading domestic AI-server core-project companies have all started technical alignment, sample supply and validation onboarding with it, and the related products will land in batch deliveries gradually from Q4 2026 into 2027. Its communications customers include mainstream AI server makers Huawei, ZTE, Inspur, xFusion and New H3C plus internet companies Alibaba and ByteDance, and in H1 the customer base expanded faster toward internet and server makers. The Alibaba project reached volume delivery in H2 2025 with more projects in development; several ByteDance projects are in development, some products are expected to start mass production in Q4 2026 and more volume delivery is expected in 2027; it also has project cooperation with Tencent. Board secretary Jiang Daocai said the company is one of Huawei's core suppliers of high-speed backplane connectors.
quarterly_data.figure: batch deliveries to domestic AI-server projects from Q4 2026 into 2027; more ByteDance volume delivery expected in 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Margins and 224G ramp (H1 2026 results briefing): general manager Liu Taiguo said the Q2 gross-margin change came mainly from the switchover between old and new communications products - the new-generation high-speed cable module is still ramping yield and efficiency, so its unit manufacturing cost is high; since July production and delivery have improved markedly, Q3 and Q4 performance should improve gradually and Q4 deliveries are expected to be relatively concentrated, based on customer order timing, the new plant's added capacity and rising yields. The company said a 224G product set carries higher value than a 112G one, and that manufacturing cost is trending down with yield gains, scale and joint cost-down work with customers, so it is confident the new generation's gross margin will keep improving. Board secretary Jiang Daocai said the new lines are designed to handle both 112G and 224G products and some newly built lines are already running. The general manager said supernode ramps will raise the use of high-speed connectors and cable modules across the system and markedly lift interconnect value per rack.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Defense and new fields (H1 2026 results briefing): general manager Liu Taiguo said H1 defense growth came mainly from underwater defense in marine equipment, aerospace missile-borne systems and nuclear power. Board secretary Jiang Daocai said its self-developed JHD-series satellite high-speed connectors were the first in China's aerospace sector to reach 25Gbps / 56Gbps (company claim) and support uses including 100G satellite payload links; several satellite connector products passed core customers' prototype and flight-model validation, became formally coded products and were delivered in small batches. Rocket-borne EWIS work produced special cable assemblies for extreme temperatures and a first commercial-space supply. In new-energy vehicles its high-voltage connectors are in batch supply to SAIC-GM-Wuling and BYD, and it developed vehicle fiber connectors and 10Gbps waterproof Ethernet connectors. Commercial space and low-altitude economy are still at the market-expansion stage and a small share of revenue; communications connection products are now the company's largest revenue source.
quarterly_data.figure: JHD satellite connectors 25Gbps / 56Gbps; support 100G payload links
